title: Elevator mirrors.
officialText:
A mirror shall be installed in each self-service passenger elevator in multiple dwellings. Such mirror
shall be affixed and maintained in a manner sufficient to enable persons entering such elevator to view the inside thereof prior to
entry to determine whether any person is in the elevator.
